key_insight: Physics-structured, non-intrusive Operator Inference can learn parametric reduced models for incompressible Navier–Stokes flows directly from POD coefficients, without explicit projection of the full equations.
engineering_relevance: This enables fast surrogate predictions of velocity and pressure for new operating conditions, supporting rapid design, control, and uncertainty studies in fluid systems.
method: Separate global POD bases are built for velocity and pressure.
Reduced operators are identified from temporal and parametric coefficients via uncoupled least-squares problems.
The framework preserves a prescribed physics-based structure while remaining non-intrusive.
evidence_signal: The method is validated on a lid-driven cavity and a porous-medium flow with a square obstacle, showing accurate reconstruction and prediction of velocity and pressure for unseen parameter values.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and coverage of training snapshots; extrapolation beyond the sampled temporal or parametric range may degrade accuracy.
paper_title: Non intrusive parametric Reduced Order Models based on physics for incompressible flow
